g.text: Create a generic 2D placeholder environment tileset for a Unity
game, art direction intentionally undefined. 16x16 seamless tiles:
grass, dirt path, stone floor, brick wall, water edge, and eight
props (crate, barrel, rock, bush, tree, torch, sign, door). Flat
colours with a 1px dark outline, consistent top-left light,
transparent PNG atlas plus a 16px grid reference image, no text.
Full prompt: Eagle annotation and request.md
